description: Oppo has unveiled the first official teaser for the Oppo A7 Pro Max, confirming a 10,000mAh battery and revealing the smartphone's rear design before its China launch. The teaser also discloses battery durability details, while pre-orders have already begun through multiple online platforms in China. Previous reports indicate the handset could feature a Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset, a 120Hz OLED display, up to 12GB of RAM, 80W wired fast charging and a dual rear camera setup.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Max Officially Teased With Massive 10,000mAh Battery Ahead of Launch

description: Garden Finance has taken its application offline after a security incident involving an external solver led to the theft of approximately $450,000 in USDT, according to Blockaid. The protocol said user funds were not affected and that the breach was limited to the solver's infrastructure. Garden is working with blockchain security firms to investigate the incident, recover the stolen assets, and complete security reviews before restoring services.
title: Blockaid Reports $450,000 Exploit as Garden Finance Disables App

description: Redmi has begun teasing the Redmi Note 17 for the Indian market through its official X account, offering a first look at the handset while drawing attention to its battery performance. Separately, a tipster has leaked the smartphone's expected Indian pricing and reiterated an August 6 launch timeline. The Redmi Note 17 recently debuted in China with Qualcomm's Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset, while reports suggest its Indian variant could feature hardware changes and may also spawn a Poco-branded model.
title: Redmi Note 17 India Launch Teased; Price in India Leaked Online
OPPO Reno16 Series: Is This the Complete Creator Device?

description: Grand Theft Auto 6's physical version will come with a digital download code in the box. Developer Rockstar Games has now detaled region restrictions on download code redemptions for PlayStation. GTA 6's download code will be tied to the region of the user's platform account.
title: Rockstar Games Details GTA 6 Digital Download Code Region Restrictions

description: Apple has reached the late-stage testing phase for three new Apple Watch models, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. Apple Watch Series 12 (Wi-Fi only), Watch Series 12 (Cellular), and Watch Ultra 4, internally codenamed N237, N238, and N240, are expected to be launched this year. However, the report indicates that the Cupertino-based tech giant will not launch the Apple Watch SE 4 this year, considering that the Watch SE 3 was launched in September 2025 with a “major refresh” and other enhancements. The company reportedly made the decision to maintain the “usual extended gap” between the two models.
title: Apple Watch Series 12, Watch Ultra 4 Might Sport a Similar Design as Last Year; Watch SE Refresh Unlikely in 2026

description: BitMart has announced a phased shutdown of its crypto exchange, with trading set to end on August 26 and all platform operations scheduled to cease by January 31, 2027. The exchange has already stopped accepting new users and deposits while restricting futures trading. The announcement follows reports of delayed withdrawals and a sharp decline in the value of BitMart's native BMX token, raising concerns among users.
title: BitMart Exchange to Cease Trading by August 26, Full Shutdown Set for 2027

description: Adidas Hyperboost Edge was launched in India on Monday as the company's latest road running shoe. As per the brand, it is positioned as a lightweight, non-plated super-trainer, which combines the company's new Hyperboost Pro midsole foam with a Primeweave upper and its Lighttraxion outsole technology. Adidas claims the shoe has been designed to provide a balance of cushioning, energy return, and lightweight performance for both daily sessions and high-intensity training.
title: Adidas Hyperboost Edge Launched in India With Hyperboost Pro Foam, Lighttraxion Outsole Technology

description: Vivo has released the first official teaser for the Vivo S2 in India, revealing key aspects of the smartphone's rear design ahead of its launch. The teaser aligns with earlier leaks that showcased the handset's camera module and overall styling. Previous reports suggest the Vivo S2 could arrive in India on August 6 and go on sale from August 11. The smartphone is also tipped to feature a high-refresh-rate display, a large battery, fast charging and multiple storage variants.
title: Vivo S2 India Launch Confirmed as Official Teaser Goes Live: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Fresh leaks have disclosed more details about the upcoming Insta360 X6 ahead of its expected launch. Images of the retail packaging indicate support for 8K 360-degree recording, up to 140 minutes of battery life and a new Replaceable Lenses 2.0 system. Separate hands-on photographs showcase the redesigned body alongside earlier models, while the packaging also reveals bundled accessories. The leaks further suggest a July 30 global debut and indicate separate bundled and standalone variants for European markets.
title: Insta360 X6 Retail Box Leak Reveals Key Details Ahead of Launch

description: Vodafone Idea has expanded its Vi Movies & TV portfolio with a new prepaid recharge that combines streaming services, live television and mobile data in one plan. The Rs. 200 pack remains valid for 28 days and provides access to 20 OTT platforms, over 200 live TV channels, 30GB of high-speed data and Unlimited 5G for eligible users. It also supports viewing across multiple devices, offers content in 16 languages and is available through the Vi app and other recharge channels.
title: Vi Launches Rs. 200 Prepaid Plan With 20 OTT Apps, Live TV, Unlimited 5G Data, and More

description: Xiaomi is said to have increased the prices of several smartphones in India. The price revision follows a growing trend, where several brands have increased smartphone prices in recent months, citing market conditions. According to a tipster, Xiaomi’s price hike affects several models in the Xiaomi and Redmi portfolio, including the Xiaomi 17T, Redmi Note 15 5G, Redmi 15 5G, and Redmi 15C 5G.
title: Xiaomi 17T, Redmi Note 15 5G, Redmi 15 Series Price in India Reportedly Hiked: Check Revised Prices

description: The Amazon Great Freedom Sale has been announced in India. It is the e-commerce giant’s Independence Day-themed annual sale event in the country, which is expected to offer deals across smartphones, accessories, laptops, home appliances, Amazon devices, and more. Amazon has also partnered with select banks to offer instant discounts on card purchases, along with additional exchange deals and no-cost EMI benefits.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale Starts August 7: Early Prime Access, Top Bank Offers and Deals Teased

description: Honor Robot Phone will be launched in China on August 12, the smartphone maker announced on Monday. The tech firm has also confirmed that the handset has been built in collaboration with the Munich-based film equipment firm ARRI. Ahead of the launch event, the tech firm will showcase the Honor Robot Phone on July 28 at 10 am local time (7:30 am IST). During the showcase, Honor will demonstrate the imaging capabilities of the handset. According to a report by The Tech Outlook, the Honor Robot Phone is currently listed on JD.com, available for pre-order in China.
title: Honor Robot Phone Launch Date Announced; Leaked Unboxing Video, Colour Options and Other Details Surface Online

description: Vivo T5e has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company's mid-range T5 lineup. The new Vivo T series smartphone is currently on sale in India via the Vivo online store, Flipkart, and other offline retail channels. The Vivo T5e is offered in Aero Blue and Shadow Grey colour options. The Vivo T5e is the company’s latest dual-SIM smartphone that runs on its latest OriginOS 6, which is based on Android 16. The handset is equipped with a 6.74-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) LCD touchscreen, which delivers up to a 90Hz refresh rate. The tech firm claims that the Vivo T5e also ships with an IP64 rating for dust and splash resistance.
title: Vivo T5e Launched in India With 5,500mAh Battery, 8-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Tomb Raider: Catalyst, the next mainline Tomb Raider game, has been delayed. Publisher Amazon Games Studios has confirmed that game will now launch in 2028. Catalyst was initally set for launch in 2027. The development comes after Crystal Dynamics confirmed Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis had been delayed from its initial 2026 launch window. The remake will now launch on February 12, 2027.
title: Amazon Games Confirms Tomb Raider: Catalyst Delay, Says 'Excited' About 007 First Light Franchise

description: iQOO Z11 will be launched in India in August, Gadgets 360 has learnt exclusively from reliable sources. The smartphone is claimed to be the first smartphone in India with the octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7500 Turbo chipset, which differs from the SoC that powers the handset’s Chinese counterpart. The upcoming handset will also be equipped with a 3D curved display in India. Since its anticipated debut in the country is a few weeks away, the Vivo sub-brand is expected to reveal more details soon.
title: [Exclusive] iQOO Z11 to Launch in India Soon With a New MediaTek Chipset, 3D Curved Display

description: A new leak has revealed almost the complete specifications of the Redmi 17 4G before its official debut. The handset is tipped to feature MediaTek's Helio G91 Ultra chipset. Other expected highlights include a 6.9-inch 120Hz display, a 50-megapixel rear camera, HyperOS 3 and a 7,500mAh battery with 45W charging. The leak also details the phone's design, memory options, connectivity features and durability certifications.
title: Redmi 17 4G Leak Suggests MediaTek Helio G91 Ultra Chip, 7,500mAh Battery

description: Poco M8 Power will be launched in India next month, the company announced on Monday. The upcoming handset is expected to arrive as the higher-end sibling of the Poco M8, which debuted in January this year. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the Xiaomi sub-brand has begun teasing the handset through its microsite on Flipkart, while also revealing some of the expected hardware. The Poco M8 Power is teased to offer up to three days of battery life on a single charge.
title: Poco M8 Power India Launch Date Announced; Teased to Offer Up to 3 Days of Battery Life

description: Apple is reportedly preparing its first smart glasses for a WWDC 2027 unveiling, with consumer availability expected later that year. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says the company has delayed the product to refine privacy protections and evaluate different camera designs. Apple is said to be developing new hardware and software safeguards, favouring on-device AI processing while avoiding features such as facial recognition. The glasses are expected to offer AI assistance, audio playback, phone calls and Siri support as part of Apple's broader 2027 hardware lineup.
title: Apple Reportedly Delays Smart Glasses to WWDC 2027 to Strengthen Privacy

description: Google Pixel 11 series will be launched at a higher price due to the ongoing "supplier-driver" memory crisis, Google’s Vice President of Devices and Services, Shakil Barkat, confirmed to 9to5Google. According to the report, Barkat pointed out, citing Morgan Stanley data, that there has been a sixfold increase in 1GB of RAM, going from $2.8 (about Rs. 270) in 2025 to $12 (roughly Rs. 1,155) in 2026. Further, he reportedly confirmed that the “entire Pixel family”, including the upcoming Google Pixel 11 series, will see a price correction that will be “rolled out dynamically to match supply realities”.
title: Google Pixel 11 Series Confirmed to Launch at Higher Prices Due to RAM Shortage: Report

description: Bitcoin traded above $65,000 as investors awaited the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision. Analysts said easing oil prices supported sentiment, but geopolitical tensions, ETF outflows and macroeconomic uncertainty continue to cap stronger gains.
title: Bitcoin Steadies Near $65,200 as Investors Await Federal Reserve Signals

description: Vivo X300 E has been launched in China as the ‘E’ variant of the standard Vivo X300. The new smartphone is currently available for pre-order in the country and is scheduled to go on sale on July 31 via the Vivo China online store. The handset is offered in Chen Yehei, Moonlight White, and Sunlight Orange (translated from Chinese) colour options. An octa core Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm powers the new Vivo X300 E. It is equipped with a 7,200mAh battery, while offering support for 90W wired fast charging. The smartphone carries a triple rear camera unit.
title: Vivo X300 E Launched With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC, 7,200mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: God of War Laufey, which was revealed at State of Play in June, will launch on PS5 on February 26, 2027, Sony and Santa Monica Studio have confirmed. The game is currently availble to wishlist on PlayStation Store. Additionally, Santa Monica has also confirmed a new God of War game featuring Kratos.
title: God of War Laufey Release Date Announced, Next God of War Game With Kratos Confirmed

description: OnePlus 16 is expected to launch later this year as the successor to the OnePlus 15. While the brand has yet to confirm any details, the purported handset was previously tipped to debut earlier than usual, possibly in September. However, a tipster suggests that OnePlus may have settled on an October launch window. The leak also sheds light on some of its expected specifications, including a 6.78-inch flat display and a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chip under the hood.
title: OnePlus 16 Tipped to Launch in October With 9,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC

description: Apple is said to be gearing up to introduce a new device leasing programme, called Apple Upgrade, tomorrow (Tuesday). According to a seasoned journalist, it is expected to cover most of the iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch models in the company’s portfolio. It will reportedly be available only in the US, allowing customers to lease an iPhone or Apple Watch for 24 months.
title: Apple Upgrade Programme Reportedly Launching on July 28 With iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch Leasing Options

description: The Vivo S2 is rumoured to mark the return of the company's S series to India after nearly six years. While the company has yet to reveal details about the purported handset, alleged dummy units of the Vivo S2 have surfaced online, which provide us with a closer look at its design. The Vivo handset is reportedly scheduled to launch on August 6, with sales tipped to commence on August 11.
title: Vivo S2 Dummy Units Reportedly Leak Ahead of India Launch; Design, Key Specifications Revealed
